Todo-list fixture contains unexpected Buy milk row - The test opened a todo list containing three visible rows instead of the expected two. This points to incorrect or leftover test data rather than a failure caused during this run.

Walk the dog is pre-marked completed in the todo fixture - The test started with Walk the dog already marked done, even though the scenario expects it to remain active. As a result, the Completed view cannot contain only Buy milk.
New todos render as numeric IDs instead of entered text - When a todo is added, the list is using its numeric identifier as the displayed text rather than the text the user entered.

Todo completion fixture does not match verification target - The starting todo data was not set up for this check: Pay rent and Walk the dog were shown as completed, while Buy milk was not. This shows an incorrect or leftover test state, not a failure caused by observing the page.
Clear completed button missing after completing a todo - The todo app updated the completed state and remaining-item count but did not display the required Clear completed footer button.

Todo-list fixture does not match expected state - The page showed two rows, “Pay rent” and “Buy milk,” while the check expected “Walk the dog” and “Pay rent.” The test assumed a starting list state that was not present.
Todo edit field remains visible after saving - The app saves the new todo text but does not leave edit mode when Enter is pressed or focus moves away.
